lead screw is________. (Answer in integer)
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 399 to 401.

number of batteries) at which the company should switch from buying to making
the batteries in the plant is________. (Answer in integer)
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 9995 to 10005.

A product has to be manufactured in a single-line layout by carrying out the six
tasks in a sequence. The time (in minute) of the six sequential tasks are 37, 8, 19,
34, 36 and 17. These tasks cannot be further sub-divided. For minimizing the cycle
time, the number of stations to be used is________. (Answer in integer)
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 5 to 5.

questions.questionText:
A through hole of 10 mm diameter is to be drilled in a mild steel plate of 30 mm
thickness. The selected spindle speed and feed for drilling hole are 600 revolutions
per minute (RPM) and 0.3 mm/rev, respectively. Take initial approach and
breakthrough distances as 3 mm each. The total time (in minute) for drilling one
hole is________. (Rounded off to two decimal places)
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 0.19 to 0.21.

questions.questionText:
In the iron-carbon equilibrium phase diagram, the eutectoid reaction occurs at
723 C with the eutectoid composition of 0.83 weight % carbon. Ferrite and
cementite phases are considered to contain 0.022 weight % carbon and 6.67 weight
% carbon, respectively. If a steel specimen with 0.7 weight % carbon is cooled from
950 C to below 723 C, the fraction of eutectoid ferrite is________. (Rounded off
to two decimal places)
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 0.72 to 0.76.

the tool is________. (Rounded off to two decimal places)
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 0.49 to 0.53.

questions.questionText:

casting is________. (Rounded off to two decimal places)
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 81.50 to 82.50.

The solidification of a casting starts at 10 AM. However, the solidification of the

is completed at the center-line of the mold. The center-line feeding resistance (CFR)
in percentage is________. (Answer in integer)
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IIT Roorkee is 70 to 70.
